item.title: Left, Right and Pseudo Inverses
item.description:
28.1 Left and Right Inverses

For any matrix \(A\), there are four fundamental subspaces: Row Space, Null Space, Column Space, Null Space of \(A^T\). Row Space and Null Space combined span entire \(\mathbb{R}^n\) for a \(m \times n\) matrix \(A\). Column Space and Null Space of \(A^T\) combined span entire \(\mathbb{R}^m\) for a \(m \times n\) matrix \(A\). For the inverse of the matrix to exist, it’s rank should be \(r=m=n\) whtere the dimension of the matrix is \(m \times n\).
